improved-heroic-strike.name: Improved Heroic Strike
improved-heroic-strike.r1: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage.
improved-heroic-strike.rmax: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 3 Rage.

improved-rend.name: Improved Rend
improved-rend.r1: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 12%.
improved-rend.rmax: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 35%.

improved-charge.name: Improved Charge
improved-charge.r1: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.
improved-charge.rmax: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 6.

improved-tactical-mastery.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
improved-tactical-mastery.r1: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 3 Rage when you change stances.
improved-tactical-mastery.rmax: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

improved-overpower.name: Improved Overpower
improved-overpower.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.
improved-overpower.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

anger-management.name: Anger Management
anger-management.r1: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.
anger-management.rmax: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

deep-wounds.name: Deep Wounds
deep-wounds.r1: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 20% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.
deep-wounds.rmax: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 60% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

spearing-strike.name: Spearing Strike
spearing-strike.cost: 15 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 20 sec cooldown
spearing-strike.r1: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.
spearing-strike.rmax: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

two-handed-weapon-specialization.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
two-handed-weapon-specialization.r1: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.
two-handed-weapon-specialization.rmax: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 3%.

impale.name: Impale
impale.r1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.
impale.rmax: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.

bloodthrill.name: Bloodthrill
bloodthrill.r1: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 4% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.
bloodthrill.rmax: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 20% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.

sweeping-strikes.name: Sweeping Strikes
sweeping-strikes.r1: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.
sweeping-strikes.rmax: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

weaponmaster.name: Weaponmaster
weaponmaster.r1: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Polearm: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor. Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.
weaponmaster.rmax: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Polearm: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.

improved-slam.name: Improved Slam
improved-slam.r1: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.25 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
improved-slam.rmax: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.5 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

improved-hamstring.name: Improved Hamstring
improved-hamstring.r1: Gives your Hamstring ability a 5% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
improved-hamstring.rmax: Gives your Hamstring ability a 15% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

mortal-strike.name: Mortal Strike
mortal-strike.cost: 30 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
mortal-strike.r1: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.
mortal-strike.rmax: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

booming-voice.name: Booming Voice
booming-voice.r1: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 10% and reduces their Rage cost by 5%.
booming-voice.rmax: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces their Rage cost by 25%.

cruelty.name: Cruelty
cruelty.r1: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.
cruelty.rmax: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

lingering-rage.name: Lingering Rage
lingering-rage.r1: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 2 sec.
lingering-rage.rmax: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 10 sec.

unbridled-wrath.name: Unbridled Wrath
unbridled-wrath.r1: Gives you a 12% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.
unbridled-wrath.rmax: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

furious-precision.name: Furious Precision
furious-precision.r1: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 4%.
furious-precision.rmax: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

piercing-howl.name: Piercing Howl
piercing-howl.r1: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
piercing-howl.rmax: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

blood-craze.name: Blood Craze
blood-craze.r1: Regenerates 1% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.
blood-craze.rmax: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

dual-wield-specialization.name: Dual Wield Specialization
dual-wield-specialization.r1: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 10%.
dual-wield-specialization.rmax: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%.

raging-blows.name: Raging Blows
raging-blows.r1: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.
raging-blows.rmax: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.r1: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 2% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.
enrage.rmax: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 10% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

improved-execute.name: Improved Execute
improved-execute.r1: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 3.
improved-execute.rmax: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

improved-berserker-rage.name: Improved Berserker Rage
improved-berserker-rage.r1: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 5 Rage and has a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.
improved-berserker-rage.rmax: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

death-wish.name: Death Wish
death-wish.r1: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.
death-wish.rmax: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

improved-intercept.name: Improved Intercept
improved-intercept.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 5 sec.
improved-intercept.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.r1: Increases your melee attack speed by 5% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
flurry.rmax: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

gore-drinker.name: Gore Drinker
gore-drinker.r1: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 0.5% of your maximum Health.
gore-drinker.rmax: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1% of your maximum Health.

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.cost: 30 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
bloodthirst.r1: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.
bloodthirst.rmax: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

improved-bloodrage.name: Improved Bloodrage
improved-bloodrage.r1: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 25%.
improved-bloodrage.rmax: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

shield-specialization.name: Shield Specialization
shield-specialization.r1: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 1% and grants you a 20% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.
shield-specialization.rmax: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

iron-will.name: Iron Will
iron-will.r1: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 3%.
iron-will.rmax: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

improved-revenge.name: Improved Revenge
improved-revenge.r1: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 20%.
improved-revenge.rmax: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

improved-thunder-clap.name: Improved Thunder Clap
improved-thunder-clap.r1: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 2.
improved-thunder-clap.rmax: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

last-stand.name: Last Stand
last-stand.r1: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.
last-stand.rmax: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

master-of-defense.name: Master of Defense
master-of-defense.r1: Grants you a 50% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.
master-of-defense.rmax: Grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

improved-disarm.name: Improved Disarm
improved-disarm.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 7 secs.
improved-disarm.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

defiance.name: Defiance
defiance.r1: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 5% while a shield is equipped.
defiance.rmax: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.

improved-sunder-armor.name: Improved Sunder Armor
improved-sunder-armor.r1: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 1.
improved-sunder-armor.rmax: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.r1: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.
vanguard.rmax: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

improved-shield-bash.name: Improved Shield Bash
improved-shield-bash.r1: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.
improved-shield-bash.rmax: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

improved-shield-wall.name: Improved Shield Wall
improved-shield-wall.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 5.5 min.
improved-shield-wall.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 11 min.

concussion-blow.name: Concussion Blow
concussion-blow.cost: 10 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 45 sec cooldown

focused-rage.name: Focused Rage
focused-rage.r1: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 1.
focused-rage.rmax: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.r1: Increases all damage you deal by 2% while a shield is equipped.
bastion.rmax: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

shield-slam.name: Shield Slam
shield-slam.cost: 20 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
shield-slam.r1: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
shield-slam.rmax: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
